references: fastmace.reference (1b-T13): float64 reference, float32 yardstick with float64 energy
processes_rule: every reference in a fresh process that builds no production engine, before the production process (scope 'calculator'); conductor decision after T10
protocol: unrelaxed 3x3x3 supercells, symmetric strain +-0.02 (hydrostatic: isotropic; full: anisotropic and shear), Gaussian rattle 0.05 A; float64 reference; gate: max error <= max(3 x that of the float32 yardstick, floor), for energy, forces, stress
